name: academic-paper
tagline_zh: 从空白页到终稿，12个Agent接力写论文。改稿、审稿、查引用、转格式全包，还带风格校准和反套路铁律。
tagline_en: From blank page to final draft, 12 agents relay to write your paper. Revise, review, cite, convert—plus style.
desc_en: 12-agent academic paper writing pipeline. 11 modes (full/plan/outline/revision/revision-coach/abstract/lit-review/format-convert/citation-check/disclosure/rebuttal-audit). 6 paper types, 5 citation formats, bilingual abstracts, LaTeX/DOCX-via-Pandoc/PDF output. Style Calibration + Writing Quality Check + Anti-Patterns with IRON RULE markers. Triggers: write paper, academic paper, guide my paper, p
why_zh: 同类工具只改文字，它连审稿意见和回复信都帮你拟好，铁律标记让套路无处遁形。
why_en: Others just edit text; this one drafts rebuttals and audits reviews, with iron-rule markers that expose clichés.
